subject: math.KT
name: K-theoretic Farrell–Jones conjecture
statement: For every discrete group G and additive G-category A, is the equivariant algebraic K-theory assembly map from the classifying space for virtually cyclic subgroups to K_*(A ⋊ G) an isomorphism in every degree?
importance: Would compute group-ring K-theory from the virtually cyclic subgroups of a group.
status_note: Proved for many major classes of groups, including hyperbolic and CAT(0) groups; arbitrary groups remain open.

subject: math.KT
name: L-theoretic Farrell–Jones conjecture
statement: For every discrete group G and additive G-category with involution A, is the assembly map for nonconnective L-theory from the family of virtually cyclic subgroups to L_*^{⟨−infinity⟩}(A ⋊ G) an isomorphism?
importance: Would organize the surgery obstructions that govern manifold classification.
status_note: The coefficient and involution formulation is explicit; many group classes are known, but the arbitrary-group conjecture is open.

subject: math.KT
name: Baum–Connes conjecture without coefficients
statement: For every countable discrete group G, is the assembly map K_*^G(E_G) → K_*(C_r^*(G)) an isomorphism, where E_G is the classifying space for proper G-actions?
importance: Relates topological equivariant K-homology to the analytic K-theory of group C*-algebras.
status_note: This entry uses trivial coefficients. The stronger conjecture with arbitrary coefficients has counterexamples.

subject: math.KT
name: Novikov higher-signature conjecture
statement: For every discrete group G, are the rational higher signatures of closed oriented smooth manifolds equipped with maps to BG invariant under orientation-preserving homotopy equivalences?
importance: Would establish homotopy invariance of important characteristic numbers involving the fundamental group.
status_note: Known for many groups, including those for which suitable assembly maps are rationally injective; the universal statement is open.

subject: math.KT
name: Bass trace conjecture over integral group rings
statement: For every group G and finitely generated projective Z[G]-module P, is its Hattori–Stallings trace supported only on the conjugacy class of the identity?
importance: Would constrain projective group-ring modules through their universal trace.
status_note: This is the integral-group-ring trace formulation, not a general rational K-theory finite-generation conjecture bearing the same name.

subject: math.KT
name: Lück determinant conjecture
statement: For every discrete group G, does every matrix over Z[G] have regular Fuglede–Kadison determinant at least one in the group von Neumann algebra?
importance: Provides the analytic control needed for approximation results and L²-torsion invariants.
status_note: The regular determinant ignores the kernel. The conjecture is known for sofic groups but remains open for arbitrary groups.

references.title: Lück, The Approximation Conjecture and the Determinant Conjecture

subject: math.KT
name: Integral Gersten injectivity in ramified mixed characteristic
statement: If A is a ramified regular local domain of mixed characteristic with fraction field F, is K_i(A) → K_i(F) injective for every i≥0?
importance: Would extend localization and cycle computations in algebraic K-theory to difficult mixed-characteristic singular arithmetic settings.
status_note: The question has integral coefficients. Reported finite-coefficient counterexamples do not disprove the integral Gersten conjecture.

references.title: Feld, Finite-coefficient Gersten injectivity fails in ramified mixed characteristic

subject: math.KT
name: Parshin conjecture
statement: For every smooth projective variety X over a finite field, is K_i(X) ⊗ Q zero for every i>0?
importance: Predicts the rational higher K-theory of proper varieties over finite fields.
status_note: Known for curves and some special varieties; the general higher-dimensional statement remains open.

subject: math.KT
name: Beilinson conjecture over finite fields
statement: For every smooth projective variety over a finite field, do rational equivalence and numerical equivalence of algebraic cycles coincide after tensoring with Q?
importance: Would identify cycle groups with their numerical realizations and simplify the structure of motives.
status_note: The finite-field and rational-coefficient hypotheses are essential; the unrestricted conjecture is open.

references.title: Kahn, A sheaf-theoretic reformulation of the Tate conjecture

subject: math.KT
name: Beilinson–Soulé vanishing conjecture for fields
statement: For every field F and integer q>0, does the rational motivic cohomology H^p(Spec F,Q(q)) vanish for every p≤0?
importance: Would provide the vanishing needed to construct categories of mixed Tate motives uniformly over fields.
status_note: Known for important classes of fields; the all-fields statement remains open. This is motivic cohomology, not a vanishing claim for all algebraic K-groups.

references.title: Kimura, On a relation of a conjecture of Goncharov to the co-Lie algebra of Bloch–Kriz mixed Tate motives
